APPROVE
The refactor keeps the same short-circuit order and per-line logic (and `entry` is definitely assigned once the combined guard is false), moves the nested branches into helpers so `ParsePodfileLock` drops well below 15, and should compile, provided `resolved` and `direct` are declared as `Dictionary<string, string>` and `List<string>`, which I couldn't check because the full source file wasn't available.
